quality_gates.protocol_approval: Phase 0 must be substantively populated and explicitly approved before Phase 1.
quality_gates.gate_1_screening_before_reading: Phase 6 screening must be completed before Phase 7 full-text reading.
quality_gates.gate_2_evidence_before_drafting: Phase 8 evidence extraction must be completed before Phase 15 drafting.
quality_gates.gate_3_claims_before_gaps: Phase 11 claim mapping must be completed before Phase 12 gap analysis.
quality_gates.final_human_qc: Phase 18 requires an explicit human quality-control record.

phases.purpose: Turn the research question into a case-neutral, reviewable and explicitly approved research protocol.
completion_conditions: protocol passes schema and substantive validation
human uncertainties are resolved or explicitly recorded
human approval is recorded
human_review_requirements: A human must approve the protocol; the agent must not approve it.

phases.purpose: Derive searchable concepts, relationships and terminology from the approved protocol.
completion_conditions: each research subquestion has adequate concept coverage
ambiguities and excluded meanings are documented
human_review_requirements: Review domain-sensitive terminology and scope boundaries.

phases.purpose: Develop database-ready query families that follow the approved protocol and concept map.
completion_conditions: query families cover the protocol without imposing fixed universal families
planned adaptations and limits are documented

phases.purpose: Run reproducible scholarly metadata searches and record results and failures without treating discovery metadata as full-text evidence.
completion_conditions: all planned searches are executed or explicitly failed
metadata records are deduplicated provisionally
no full-text claims are inferred
human_review_requirements: Review source coverage and unresolved adapter failures.

phases.purpose: Expand discovery through backward, forward and related-source tracing with reproducible provenance.
completion_conditions: planned tracing paths are completed or explicitly unavailable
new candidates retain their discovery lineage
human_review_requirements: Review stopping rationale and possible citation-network bias.

phases.purpose: Create stable source identities and lawfully acquire available full text while preserving access and file provenance.
completion_conditions: candidate identities are normalized
retrieval status is explicit for every retained source
bibliography entries trace to registry records
human_review_requirements: Resolve identity collisions and any license ambiguity.

phases.purpose: Apply approved eligibility criteria at explicit stages and preserve each inclusion, exclusion or uncertainty decision.
completion_conditions: every candidate has a current decision
exclusions use standardized reasons
uncertain items are resolved or escalated
human_review_requirements: Adjudicate unresolved eligibility decisions and approve any criteria amendment.

phases.purpose: Read included full texts and record source-grounded notes with page, section, figure or table locations.
completion_conditions: all included and available sources have structured notes
missing full text is reported rather than inferred
human_review_requirements: Review difficult interpretations and sources used only at abstract level.

phases.purpose: Convert verified reading notes into universal evidence records plus composable research-type extensions.
completion_conditions: material findings, arguments or propositions are represented
missing values and uncertainty remain explicit
records trace to sources
human_review_requirements: Review coding judgments that materially affect interpretation.

phases.purpose: Organize extracted evidence into defensible thematic, theoretical, methodological and controversy maps.
completion_conditions: maps cover the review questions
alternative organizations and sparse areas are identified
human_review_requirements: Review interpretive grouping and competing synthesis frames.

phases.purpose: Identify contexts, populations, periods, materials, methods and assumptions that bound the synthesized evidence.
completion_conditions: major applicability limits and counterconditions are documented
unknown boundaries are labeled
human_review_requirements: Review generalization limits and domain-specific assumptions.

phases.purpose: Formulate review claims at a strength justified by supporting, contradictory, null and uncertain evidence.
completion_conditions: each claim links to auditable evidence
contradictions and prohibited overclaims are recorded
human_review_requirements: Review consequential claims and confidence assignments.

phases.purpose: Identify research gaps only after distinguishing true evidence gaps from disagreements, method limits and unsearched areas.
completion_conditions: each gap is typed and evidenced
search limitations are not presented as field-wide absence
human_review_requirements: Review the importance and defensibility of proposed gaps.

phases.purpose: Design an argument-led review structure that answers the approved questions and reflects the claim and gap maps.
completion_conditions: each section has a purpose and claim path
coverage and ordering decisions are explicit
human_review_requirements: Approve the argument architecture before detailed drafting.

phases.purpose: Specify each planned section's claims, evidence, counterevidence, boundaries and citation needs before prose drafting.
completion_conditions: every substantive section has an auditable brief
citation and uncertainty requirements are explicit
human_review_requirements: Review section-level emphasis and omitted evidence.

phases.purpose: Draft the review from approved briefs using only traceable claims and evidence with calibrated language.
completion_conditions: draft addresses every approved section
citations and limitations are present
unsupported statements are removed or flagged
human_review_requirements: Review narrative balance, wording and disciplinary conventions.

phases.purpose: Reconcile draft citations, source identities and bibliography records without inventing missing metadata.
completion_conditions: all draft citations resolve to registry sources
duplicates and incomplete fields are reported
human_review_requirements: Resolve metadata conflicts that cannot be determined mechanically.

phases.purpose: Audit every substantive draft claim against the claim map, exact evidence, source basis, counterevidence and wording limits.
completion_conditions: each material claim has an audit verdict
unsupported or overstated prose is identified for correction
human_review_requirements: Review high-consequence failures and disputed interpretations independently of drafting.

phases.purpose: Record final human review of scope, methods, evidence traceability, uncertainty, writing and unresolved limitations.
completion_conditions: a named human records approval or non-approval
remaining limitations and release decision are explicit
human_review_requirements: A human reviewer must sign the quality-control record; the agent must not self-sign.
